transcript.en: Kevin, I’ve read your draft about nursing-related jobs in Australia.
transcript.zh: 凯文，我读了你的关于澳大利亚护理相关工作的初稿。

transcript.en: I want to hear your thought about it, so I’ll know if you are on the right track.
transcript.zh: 我想听听你的想法，以便得知你的方向是否正确。

transcript.en: OK. Let me first share what I discovered from my initial research.
transcript.zh: 好的。先分享一下我最初的研究发现。

transcript.en: I found out that the nursing profession began quite late in Australia, in the early 20th century.
transcript.zh: 我发现澳大利亚的护理行业起步很晚，在20世纪初。

transcript.en: Right. It took some time for Australians to realize there was a need for nurses to take care of patients.
transcript.zh: 对。经过一些时间，澳大利亚人才意识到需要护士来照顾病人。

transcript.en: So when the new career emerged, people respected it.
transcript.zh: 所以当新职业出现时，人们尊重它。

transcript.en: However, there weren’t many professional nurses who could train new nurses there.
transcript.zh: 但是，能够培养新护士的专业护士并不多。

transcript.en: So, nurses had to go to America or England to receive their training.
transcript.zh: 所以，护士不得不去美国或英国接受培训。

transcript.en: And this was very expensive!
transcript.zh: 这是非常昂贵的！

transcript.en: Yes, that was a big problem back then. But learning from others was what Australians must do before they established their own training system.
transcript.zh: 是的，那在当时是个大问题。但是向他人学习是澳大利亚人在建立自己的培训体系之前必须做的。

transcript.en: What was your finding after this period of time?
transcript.zh: 那个时间段之后你的发现是什么？

transcript.en: I found that in the 1940s when the training courses for nursing were just established, they copied the Western system and had the nurses trained for eight hours a day.
transcript.zh: 我发现在20世纪40年代刚刚开设护理培训班的时候，他们照搬西方的制度，让护士每天接受八小时的培训。

transcript.en: But many students dropped out of the program due to unknown reasons, and training was often suspended because of financial difficulties.
transcript.zh: 但很多学生因为不明原因退学，培训也经常因为经济困难而停止。

transcript.en: So, the result was not very satisfying in the beginning.
transcript.zh: 所以，一开始结果就不尽人意。

transcript.en: All things need time to develop and a lot of difficulties could emerge at the earliest stage.
transcript.zh: 所有的事情都需要时间去发展，一开始会出现很多困难。

transcript.en: Yes. So for the second part, I wrote about the solutions to these problems.
transcript.zh: 是的。所以对于第二部分，我写了关于这些问题的解决方案。

transcript.en: With the effort of the government, training became quite professional by the end of the 1950s. In the 1960s, nurses, especially those who worked in the country, faced another challenge.
transcript.zh: 到20世纪50 年代末，在政府的努力下，培训变得相当专业。在20世纪60 年代，护士，尤其是那些在乡下工作的护士，面临着另一个挑战。

transcript.en: Even though nurses could easily find a job, and the work environment was acceptable, the hospitals became more specialized.
transcript.zh: 虽然护士很容易找到工作，工作环境也可以接受，但医院变得更加专业。

transcript.en: As a result, a lot of nurses were not able to perform well enough in particular departments.
transcript.zh: 结果，很多护士在特定科室的表现不够好。

transcript.en: Yes. You may add this comment: the training resources in the countryside were not equal to those in the cities, but when nursing became a course in medical schools, the situation became better.
transcript.zh: 是的。你可以补充一句：农村的培训资源不如城市，但是当护理成为医学院的课程后，情况有所改善。

transcript.en: Ok. Some of the diseases or injuries were quite complicated, which required the nurses to have more advanced skills, so that they could further assist the doctors to better help the patients.
transcript.zh: 好的。有的疾病或伤势比较复杂，需要护士有更高级的技能，才能进一步协助医生更好地帮助病人。

transcript.en: After the research, you may have learned that nursing is a very important occupation.
transcript.zh: 经过研究，你可能已经了解到护理是一个非常重要的职业。

transcript.en: Professional nursing schools play important roles in cultivating the nurses.
transcript.zh: 专业护士学校在培养护士方面发挥着重要作用。

transcript.en: Now, there are many students who are learning nursing in Australia.
transcript.zh: 现在，有很多学生在澳大利亚学习护理。

transcript.en: Nursing departments have become a very important sector in hospitals.
transcript.zh: 护理科已经成为医院非常重要的部门。

transcript.en: Yeah. Lots of the nurses are well trained now and there are different kinds of nurses in hospitals.
transcript.zh: 是的。现在很多护士都训练有素，医院里的护士种类也很多。

transcript.en: But the news keeps revealing the fact that there are too many patients, the number of nurses might not meet the demand.
transcript.zh: 但新闻还是报道，病人太多，护士人数可能无法满足需求。

transcript.en: I think the hospitals need to improve their booking system so that resources can be made the most of.
transcript.zh: 我认为医院需要改进他们的预约系统，以便充分利用资源。

transcript.en: That’s a very good point, Kevin. I think you have gathered enough information for your paper.
transcript.zh: 这是一个很好的观点，凯文。我认为你已经为你的论文收集了足够的信息。

transcript.en: So, let’s see what problem you have in your draft.
transcript.zh: 那么，我们来看看你的初稿存在的问题。

transcript.en: I’ve read it and I think even though it was quite good in general, several changes could be made to make it better.
transcript.zh: 我读了，我认为它总体上非常好，但可以作些更改以使其更好。

transcript.en: Ok, what are the weak parts?
transcript.zh: 好的，弱的方面是什么？

transcript.en: It seems like you have written a very long background of the nursing industry.
transcript.zh: 看起来你写了很长的护理行业背景。

transcript.en: I don’t think it is necessary.
transcript.zh: 我觉得没必要。

transcript.en: It’s not related to your main idea, and there are too many words in this part.
transcript.zh: 这和你的主题无关，这部分字太多了。

transcript.en: OK. It does sound very redundant. I will get rid of it.
transcript.zh: 好的。听起来确实很多余。我会删减。

transcript.en: And for nurse categories, you have listed several kinds, but I think you should provide more details for each kind, like what kind of job responsibilities each kind of nurse would have.
transcript.zh: 对于护士类别，你列出了几种，但我认为你应该给每种类别提供更多的细节，比如每种护士会有什么样的工作职责。

transcript.en: All right, I will look for more information about that aspect.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会找找更多这方面的信息。

transcript.en: How is the part about work conditions I have written? Do I need to make any changes to it?
transcript.zh: 我写的关于工作条件的部分怎么样？我需要对其进行任何更改吗？

transcript.en: That part was quite well written, so you can leave it as it is.
transcript.zh: 那部分写得很好，所以你可以保持原样。

transcript.en: However, the part for nursing courses is too simple.
transcript.zh: 但是护理课程的部分太简单了。

transcript.en: You should include extra information to make it clearer, like what skills students would learn exactly.
transcript.zh: 你应该加上额外的信息以使其更清晰，例如学生将具体学习哪些技能。

transcript.en: I’ll keep that in mind. I probably should do some research about paper revising so I can avoid making the same mistakes.
transcript.zh: 我记住了。我可能应该对论文修改做一些研究，这样我就可以避免犯同样的错误。

transcript.en: Right. And let’s see…the future of nursing, you have given good prediction of this career, and I don’t really think there is much to change.
transcript.zh: 对。再看看……护理的未来，你对这个职业给出了很好的预测，我认为无需大改。

transcript.en: OK, I guess there are still many things that I need to do before I submit my final paper to you. Thank you for your help.
transcript.zh: 好的，我想我还需要做很多事情，才能向您提交我的期末论文。谢谢您的帮助。

transcript.en: You are welcome, Kevin.
transcript.zh: 不客气，凯文。
